qol__mode_select__remove_adventure__mark.description: Mark only the Adventure Mode Select entry unavailable, matching NUN6's filtered-carousel behavior.

qol__mode_select__remove_shop__mark_entr.description: Mark only the Shop Mode Select entry unavailable using the existing filtered-carousel behavior.

qol__practice__command_display_off_by_de.description: Force command display off while preserving the following settings-field reload.

qol__practice__support_off_by_default__f.description: Force support off instead of leaving the previous settings-block value unchanged.

qol__save_load__display_only_first_save_.description: Advance status 0x0A without constructing its informational screen, then retain native dispatch for every other status.
Center the date and play-time block at local X 45 inside the compact panel.
Center the single save record at local Y 20 inside the compact panel.
Enter the sole-slot save path before constructing the redundant slot-list screen.
Exit the save controller when the final confirmation returns No instead of reopening the removed slot list.
Exit the save controller when the no-save-data confirmation returns No instead of resetting the save flow to its initial prompt.
Ignore downward slot navigation before it changes selection or plays the navigation sound.
Ignore upward slot navigation before it changes selection or plays the navigation sound.
Limit the shared Save/Load slot-row renderer to its first record.
Move the redundant slot-number record outside the viewport.
Move the upper Save/Load panel to centered X 146.
Move the upper Save/Load panel to detached Y 90 above the lower panel.
Prepare the status-0x0A modal-helper argument before its save-flow bypass.
Retain the helper's zero second argument when the unformatted save-flow bypass is not taken.
Return to the Main Menu when the unformatted format confirmation returns No instead of entering the save restart state.
Route memory-card status dispatch through the unformatted-screen bypass.
Select slot zero and enter its native save confirmation without rendering the slot list.
Shrink the upper Save/Load panel height from 224 to 96.
Shrink the upper Save/Load panel width from 400 to 224.
Skip the unformatted-card informational modal helper and supply its completed result in the save flow.
Suppress the obsolete independent save-slot cursor model draw.
Suppress row separators when only one record is rendered.
